profile.summary: larsgw is a senior-level JavaScript developer with deep expertise in Node.js and npm's core package management system. Their contributions focus on the npm CLI's internals, particularly dependency resolution, versioning logic, and package distribution workflows. With 22 PRs exclusively in the npm_cli repository, they demonstrate specialized knowledge of how npm handles optional dependencies, scoped packages, Git-based resolutions, and security audits. Their work spans both core functionality and experimental features, showing strong debugging skills and community engagement in npm's development process.
